description: Regression case discovered incidentally on 2026-09-21 while fixing check_soul_disambiguation_clause_present's own test-order flakiness: agent/prompt_builder.py's load_soul_md silently truncates SOUL.md at config.yaml's context_file_max_chars (falling back to a flat 20000-char floor with no override) - and this content actually lands at the END of the file: CUSTOMER/END-USER COMMUNICATION's disambiguation clause and the repeat-nudge cap both live past the halfway point. SOUL.md has grown steadily across sessions fixing real production incidents in it; this case exists so the next growth doesn't silently start dropping rules off the end with zero warning surfaced anywhere except a debug-level log line.
user_message: n/a - file-size check, not a conversational case

judge.pass_criteria: SOUL.md's real character count stays under config.yaml's real context_file_max_chars with real margin - every rule in the file reaches the model, not just the first N thousand characters.
judge.fail_criteria: SOUL.md's size meets or exceeds the configured budget - some rules (right now, whatever sits past the truncation point) silently never reach the model, a production risk with no loud failure mode today.
